defipunkd.value: Control: tentative orange (2/3 models submitted) · Ability to exit: tentative red · Autonomy: tentative red · Open Access: tentative orange (2/3 models submitted) · Verifiability: tentative green
defipunkd.summary: SparkLend is a decentralized non-custodial lending protocol forked from Aave V3. Users supply assets to liquidity pools to earn interest or borrow against collateral. SparkLend benefits from direct stablecoin liquidity provided by the Sky Protocol (formerly MakerDAO), enabling large-scale DAI/USDS borrowing at governance-set rates. Governed by Sky Governance with emergency controls delegated to a 3-of-5 multisig via the SparkLendFreezerMom contract.

details.name: Control
details.description: Control path unresolved — Ethereum SparkLend is upgradeable through Sky's Pause Proxy, but the live governance delay, multisigs, emergency roles, and xDai admin path were not fully resolved.

details.name: Ability to exit
details.description: Multisig can pause withdrawals indefinitely — Assessed by 3 models — Choosing red because the 3-of-5 freezer multisig holds permanent ward authorization to call pauseAllMarkets(true) without a time limit. The GitHub documentation explicitly states the FreezerMom contract allows 'bypass[ing] the 2-day GSM window' but nowhere specifies a maximum pause duration. The contract code shows pauseMarket and pauseAllMarkets accept a boolean parameter with no timestamp check or auto-expiry logic. While governance CAN reverse a pause through an executive vote (subject to the 30-hour GSM delay per the April 2024 governance decision), the multisig itself can maintain the pause indefinitely without governance action. This means a 3-of-5 actor set can unilaterally block all user exits for an unlimited period, which falls squarely into the red category under the rubric: 'ANY actor can pause CLAIMS of finalized exits indefinitely.'

details.name: Autonomy
details.description: Oracle failure risks ~100% TVS unmitigated — Assessed by 2 models — Choosing red because the strongest red case directly matches the deployed oracle architecture: both the large Ethereum module and the active Gnosis module rely on external, mutable price sources, the live fallback only handles missing or nonpositive prices, and a positive misprice can affect borrowing and liquidation solvency. Module weighting: Ethereum Pool holds ~95%+ of identifiable TVS and is red, with more than $1.4B visible in only spwstETH, spDAI, and spWETH cash balances; Gnosis Pool is ~<5%/not fully measured and is also red; weighted overall = red because the worst unmitigated oracle dependency can affect essentially all collateralized SparkLend TVS.

details.name: Open Access
details.description: Open onchain access — Core SparkLend actions are open onchain; official frontend restrictions found were passive legal terms

details.name: Verifiability
details.description: Verified source, audited, zero post-audit drift — Assessed by 3 models — Choosing green because (1) both the proxy contract and its current implementation are verified on Etherscan (the proxy page resolves and displays the implementation ABI, per evidence from the Etherscan search result), (2) a public source repo with a pinned release commit exists at sparkdotfi/sparklend-v1-core, (3) ChainSecurity — a recognized firm — conducted a deployment verification confirming bytecode-repo correspondence at the April 2023 launch, and (4) the Aave v3 codebase underlying SparkLend was audited by Trail of Bits, OpenZeppelin, PeckShield, SigmaPrime, and Certora. The orange steel-man (post-audit implementation upgrade) is noted in unknowns but is insufficient to downgrade without evidence of material drift from a fund-custody-critical change, given the extensive layered audit coverage and the stable nature of the Aave v3 core.

defipunkd.note: DeFiPunk’d files Spark as SparkLend ("sparklend"). Grades cover the deployment on every chain it runs on, not Ethereum mainnet alone, and DeFiPunk’d publishes no date with them.

defiscan.summary: Spark is a lending protocol built on an Aave V3 fork (SparkLend) with an integrated savings layer that routes deposits through the Sky (formerly MakerDAO) DAI Savings Rate (DSR) via the Pot contract. Governance decisions execute through the Sky governance stack — DSPause enforces a 24-hour delay before DSPauseProxy forwards calls to SubProxy, which holds admin rights on every SparkLend contract. An Asset Liability Management (ALM) layer controlled by three separate multisigs lets the protocol rebalance capital via arbitrary external calls. Price data comes from a mix of Chainlink, Chronicle, RedStone, and protocol-specific exchange-rate oracles for liquid staking and restaking tokens. The p…

details.name: DSPauseProxy (Sky Governance Executor)
details.description: governance · Immutable — The execution endpoint of the Sky governance stack. DSPause plots a governance spell here after the 24-hour delay, and DSPauseProxy then delegatecalls it — effectively routing every governance action against Spark contracts. It is the root admin of SubProxy, SDAO, ESM, and StarGuard. Because every upgrade and parameter change in SparkLend ultimately resolves to this contract, it controls $5.67B i…

details.name: ESM (Emergency Shutdown Module)
details.description: Immutable — Sky's Emergency Shutdown Module. When enough MKR/SKY is burned into the ESM to cross a configured threshold, it can call `exec` on SubProxy to trigger Sky governance. In Spark's permission graph it appears as an admin of SubProxy, but it is only activated during a system-wide Sky emergency shutdown.

details.name: StarGuard (Sky Authority Registry)
details.description: Immutable — Sky's authority contract registered as admin of SubProxy via the `can` access-control pattern. It whitelists which addresses may call which functions on SubProxy, and is itself administered by DSPauseProxy.

details.name: SubProxy (Sky Governance Relay)
details.description: Immutable — Owned by DSPauseProxy and registered as the admin, owner, or `PoolAdmin`/`EmergencyAdmin` role-holder on virtually every Spark contract. Through its 116 permissioned entry points it can add/drop reserves, change interest rate strategies, upgrade ATokens via PoolConfigurator, change the price oracle, reassign access-control roles, and move treasury funds in Collector. Controls $5.67B in directly h…

details.name: SparkLendFreezerMom (Emergency Freeze Contract)
details.description: Immutable — An immutable protocol contract owned by the 3/5 Emergency Freezer multisig. It is registered as `EmergencyAdmin` and `RiskAdmin` on the ACLManager, letting it bypass standard governance delays to freeze or pause SparkLend markets. It is a relay — the real authority is the owner multisig.

details.name: Weights
details.description: pigi’s fixed formula: score = 0.6 × node rating + 0.4 × vault score. With no rated vault the node rating stands alone.

pigi.note: Headline: sparklend. Vault score counts Ethereum vaults only.

text: score = 0.6 × the protocol node's own rating + 0.4 × the TVL-weighted mean (weight = tvl_30d_ma share) of the latest published score of every rated vault that deposits into it; with no rated vault the node rating stands alone (applied.k1 = 1). The band is read straight off the thresholds, without the dwell rule that smooths vault bands, so it can move on any day. A vault that deposits into more than one protocol node (every Morpho vault: the framework and the Blue instance) counts toward each. Vault scores are the published ones — their caps were computed against the node rating as of their own date, so after a node re-rate the two terms agree again at the next nightly. chain_id narrows the vault set only.

risklayer.summary: Spark is a Sky/Maker ecosystem capital allocator with roughly $4.8B TVL across eight chains, offering SparkLend (Aave v3 fork), Spark Savings vaults, and a $2.1B cross-chain liquidity layer. It has operated since 2023 with no direct fund losses and one of DeFi's stronger audit programs (22+ tier-1 reviews, $5M Immunefi bounty). Primary risks are deep Sky/USDS dependency, 13 unverified contracts (22%) including L2 governance executors, executive control via Sky's SubProxy rather than SPK token voting, and acute SPK token unlock pressure in June 2026. Overall risk is moderate at 4.9/10.

details.name: Dependency Risk

Sky Pause Proxy can authorize and execute changes without an on-chain delay at the SubProxy layer.
